page_title: AUG 1-0 BOC | Augsburg v Bochum 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.

90+5' Steve Mounie (Augsburg) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
90+4' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+4' A pass into the box finds Steve Mounie (Augsburg) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Patrick Drewes denies him.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+3' Steve Mounie (Augsburg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
86' Jakov Medic (Bochum) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' The game is interrupted. Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
83' Bernardo (Bochum) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tobias Reichel ignores the protests.
82' The referee gives a yellow card to Steve Mounie (Augsburg).
80' It will be a substitution. Steve Mounie (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Alexis Claude-Maurice walks off.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Arne Maier (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Elvis Rexhbecaj can be given a rest.
80' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
75' Dieter Hecking has decided to substitute Maximilian Wittek and he is replaced by Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum).
75' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 12:5.
74' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
73' Referee Tobias Reichel has finally had enough of Dieter Hecking and brandishes a yellow card at him!
72' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Ivan Ordets (Bochum) for a tough tackle.
70' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Nediljko Labrovic makes a comfortable save.
68' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Maximilian Wittek (Bochum), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
67' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Marius Wolf (Augsburg), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
65' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Augsburg due to an offside in the build-up play.
65' Substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) replaces Anthony Losilla.
65' The Augsburg players joy may have been justified, because referee Tobias Reichel is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
65' Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) has a goal ruled out for offside!
64' Corner kick. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
63' One of the Augsburg players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
62' Rough tackle by Philipp Hofmann (Bochum). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Augsburg was in an offside position.
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Moritz Broschinski walks off the pitch to be replaced by Koji Miyoshi (Bochum).
59' Dieter Hecking has decided to make a change. Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) replaces Lukas Daschner.
59' Phillip Tietz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Samuel Essende (Augsburg).
56' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
55' The linesman makes the right call and Augsburg will have a corner.
54' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sends the corner into the box, but Patrick Drewes intercepts it and averts the threat.
51' Bernardo (Bochum) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
49' An attempted cross from Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) is cleared.
46' Dieter Hecking has made a change at the break. Bernardo (Bochum) has come on in place of Tim Oermann.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Felix Passlack (Bochum) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
43' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
38' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Patrick Drewes no chance!
37' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
36' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Augsburg.
34' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
34' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Felix Passlack (Bochum), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
32' A player from Bochum commits a rough challenge. Tobias Reichel blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
30' 4:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
26' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sees a yellow card from Tobias Reichel after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
23' Augsburg are ruled offside.
18' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
17' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tobias Reichel didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
12' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
3' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) causes Patrick Drewes little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
2' Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Augsburg will take the kick-off.
Tobias Reichel will supervise the game today.
